questions.question: Drivers should be careful when passing large vehicles. They should not drive beside large vehicles for long periods of time.
questions.explanation: Large vehicles have big blind spots on both sides. Do not drive beside a large vehicle for a long time. It is safer to either fall back or move ahead.

questions.question: If there is no crosswalk and a pedestrian is crossing your lane, you should:

options.text: Make sure the pedestrian can see you before proceeding.
Stop and let the pedestrian finish crossing.

questions.correctAnswerText: Stop and let the pedestrian finish crossing.
questions.explanation: Drivers must always let pedestrians cross safely. This is true even if there is no marked crosswalk.

questions.question: To be safe when crossing railroad tracks, you should:

options.text: Look both ways, but only when the red light is flashing.
Listen, look both ways, and then proceed if it is safe.
Cross quickly when a train is approaching.
Quickly pass under any lowering gates.

questions.correctAnswerText: Listen, look both ways, and then proceed if it is safe.
questions.explanation: Railroad crossings are always dangerous. Look and listen for trains coming from either direction. Watch for warning signals. Never cross until you are sure it is safe.

questions.question: If you become tired while driving, the best thing to do is:

options.text: Stop to rest or change drivers.

questions.correctAnswerText: Stop to rest or change drivers.
questions.explanation: If you are tired while driving, stop to rest or let someone else drive. Tiredness slows your thinking and reactions, which makes driving dangerous.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Fines double in a work zone.

questions.explanation: Warning signs are usually yellow with black markings. They tell drivers about upcoming road conditions and hazards. This sign warns drivers that bicycles may cross the road ahead.

questions.question: When you see a steady red traffic light, you should:

options.text: Drive through if there is no other traffic.
Continue driving because you have the right-of-way.
Stop only if a police officer is nearby.

questions.explanation: A steady red light means you must stop completely. Driving through a red light is illegal and very dangerous. You may turn right on red only if there is no sign that forbids it.

questions.question: Drivers who eat and drink while driving:

options.text: Are better drivers because they are not hungry.

questions.explanation: Eating, drinking, or smoking while driving is dangerous. These activities take your hands off the wheel and your eyes off the road. Drivers doing these things have trouble staying in their lanes and controlling their vehicles.

questions.question: To avoid becoming an aggressive driver:

options.text: Drive above the posted speed limit.
Tailgate the driver in front of you.

questions.explanation: To avoid becoming an aggressive driver, relax and focus on driving. Do not take other drivers' actions personally. Plan enough time for your trip, drive at the speed limit, and be patient with other drivers.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: No turns are allowed on this road.

questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow with black markings. They warn about conditions just ahead. This sign warns drivers of an upcoming winding road with curves.

questions.question: If you feel tired while driving, the best thing to do is:
questions.explanation: Driving while tired is as dangerous as driving while impaired. If you feel tired while driving, stop and do not continue.

questions.question: Only vehicles with disability license plates or parking placards can park in reserved disability parking spaces.
questions.explanation: Reserved disability parking spaces can only be used by vehicles with disability license plates, disabled veteran license plates, or disabled parking placards.

questions.question: What happens to drivers who drink alcohol before driving?

options.text: They always know the risks they are taking.
They cannot control their body, mind, or vehicle properly.
They drive better because they are more careful.

questions.correctAnswerText: They cannot control their body, mind, or vehicle properly.
questions.explanation: Alcohol slows your brain and body. It harms your judgment, vision, focus, and reaction time. Never drink any amount of alcohol before driving.

questions.question: How should you change lanes?

options.text: When a car is in your blind spot.

questions.explanation: Change lanes slowly and carefully, only when needed. Each lane change raises the risk of an accident.

questions.question: When can you pass another vehicle?

options.text: On a road with a solid line next to your lane.
On a road with a dashed line next to your lane.

questions.correctAnswerText: On a road with a dashed line next to your lane.
questions.explanation: A dashed line means you can cross it to change lanes. A solid line means you cannot pass. Only change lanes when it is safe.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign means U-turns are not allowed at this location.

questions.question: You must give the right-of-way to children playing in the street.
questions.explanation: Drive very carefully where children are present. Slow down near schools, playgrounds, and residential areas.

questions.question: What can reduce road rage?

options.text: Talk on your cell phone while driving.

questions.explanation: To prevent road rage, follow all traffic laws, signs, signals, and road markings. Always signal before changing lanes.

questions.question: Before changing lanes, you should:

options.text: Turn your head to check for vehicles in your blind spot.

questions.explanation: Check both mirrors for traffic behind you. Then quickly look over your shoulder to check your blind spot before moving into another lane.

questions.question: You must yield to a pedestrian with a white cane or guide dog:

options.text: Only when the guide dog is leading them across the street.
Only if a crossing guard is present.

questions.explanation: Always give the right-of-way to pedestrians using white canes or guide dogs.

questions.question: Smoking while driving:
questions.explanation: Smoking while driving is dangerous because it takes your hands off the wheel and your eyes off the road.

questions.question: Why should you not stop suddenly in front of large trucks and buses?

options.text: Small vehicle drivers cannot see large trucks and buses in their rearview mirrors.
Large trucks and buses need longer distances to stop because of their size and weight.
Large trucks and buses travel faster than small vehicles.

questions.correctAnswerText: Large trucks and buses need longer distances to stop because of their size and weight.
questions.explanation: Large vehicles need more time and distance to stop than smaller vehicles. If you stop suddenly in front of a large vehicle, the driver may not be able to stop in time to avoid hitting you.

questions.question: How can alcohol affect you as a driver?

options.text: It makes you feel overly confident.
It reduces your ability to think clearly.

questions.explanation: Alcohol affects your brain's judgment and self-control. It slows your reaction time, reduces coordination, and weakens your balance. It also hurts your vision and ability to judge distance, making it harder to respond to what happens around you.

questions.question: What can impair a person's ability to drive?
questions.explanation: Safe driving requires you to be in good physical condition. Alcohol, legal and illegal drugs, and drowsiness can all impair your driving ability.

questions.question: When a curb is painted ____, it shows fire zone parking restrictions.
questions.explanation: Painted curbs show parking rules. A red curb means no parking is allowed in that fire zone.

questions.question: What should a driver do when pedestrians are crossing at a crosswalk?

options.text: Continue ahead. You have the right-of-way.
Wait for the pedestrians to finish crossing.
Go around the pedestrians to the right.

questions.correctAnswerText: Wait for the pedestrians to finish crossing.
questions.explanation: Drivers must let pedestrians cross at a crosswalk. Wait until the crosswalk is clear before you drive forward.
